Ever since I have been at this practice it’s been the nightmare of my life.

The doctors are actually amazing, but the front of house is a clicky, clicky shambles.
They are condescending towards me talk about me,  block me from getting the pain medication I am in need of I am so sick to death of them.

How can I be in a doctors practice that I don’t even want to phone up to.
I even have video evidence of how the physiotherapist went on whilst I visited him.
